facts.statement: Dashanpusaurus was described in 2005 by a team of Chinese paleontologists led by Peng Guangzhao.
facts.quote: The dinosaur was described in 2005 by Peng Guangzhao, Ye Yong, Gao Yuhui, Shu Chunkang, and Jiang Shan.

facts.statement: The holotype of Dashanpusaurus is a partial skeleton without a skull found in the Dashanpu township of Sichuan, China.
facts.quote: The Dashanpusaurus holotype, ZDM 5028, a partial skeleton lacking the skull, was unearthed in the Sichuan, China township of Dashanpu

facts.statement: Numerous Dashanpusaurus specimens have been recovered from the Dashanpu area in addition to the holotype.
facts.quote: Other than the dinosaur's holotype, numerous other Dashanpusaurus specimens have been recovered from the area

facts.statement: Dashanpusaurus lived approximately 165 million years ago during the Bathonian and Callovian stages of the Middle Jurassic in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 165 millones de años, en el Bathoniense y Calloviense en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: The time range for Dashanpusaurus is estimated to be from 170.9 to 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Oxfordian (170.9 to 154.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: Dashanpusaurus is estimated to have reached a length of 17 meters, a height of 5 meters, and a weight of 20 tonnes.
facts.quote: Se estima que llegó a medir 17 metros de largo, 5 de alto y a pesar 20 toneladas.

facts.statement: Dashanpusaurus was a quadrupedal herbivore, consistent with most sauropods.
facts.quote: Dashanpusaurus was a herbivore and was quadrupedal, like most others in the Sauropoda.

facts.statement: In 2022, Dashanpusaurus was identified as the most basal member of the Macronaria clade.
facts.quote: In 2022, it was found to be the most basal macronarian.

facts.statement: Dashanpusaurus is classified within the family Camarasauridae.
Dashanpusaurus belongs to the parent group Macronaria.

rejected.statement: Dashanpusaurus is an extinct genus of sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Middle Jurassic period.
rejected.quote: Dashanpusaurus (meaning "Dashanpu lizard" after the township it was discovered in) is an extinct genus of sauropod dinosaur that lived during the middle of the Jurassic period.

rejected.statement: A 2013 phylogenetic analysis placed Dashanpusaurus as a non-neosauropod eusauropod, more derived than Shunosaurus but more basal than Barapasaurus.
rejected.quote: A phylogenetic analysis conducted by Mo Jinyou in 2013 recovered Dashanpusaurus as a non-neosauropod eusauropod, more derived than Shunosaurus but more basal than Barapasaurus.
